notes:
Access: same as Bestsellers/Clearance passes - /shop/* blocked by Akamai 403 at tier 1 (curl_cffi) and tier 2 (headless Playwright); reached via Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3, real Chrome). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow.

Navigation: main nav 'New' tab's canonical destination is /shop/new/all-new/, title 'Latest Furniture & Home Decor | New Home Decor | Pottery Barn', page header 'All New Arrivals', breadcrumb 'New'. Opened and confirmed it is a genuine, real product listing (not editorial/lookbook) - browsable grid with filter/sort controls, individual products carrying 'New' badges (and, as expected overlap, some also carrying 'Bestseller' badges), plus a real rendered item-count header. This is the site's own dedicated New Arrivals PLP and was recorded as the sole row.

The same page also displays department tiles (Furniture, Bedding, Pillows & Decor, Tabletop & Bar, Outdoor & Garden, Mirrors & Art, Bath) visually identical in structure to the confirmed Bestsellers hub's department sub-pages (see bs3.json), strongly suggesting genuine New-Arrivals-by-department child PLPs exist analogous to the Bestsellers ones. However, their individual URLs/counts were not captured in this pass - the shared Claude-in-Chrome browser session (contended by 10 concurrent workers running the same task on other companies simultaneously) repeatedly reset/invalidated tabs, and time was prioritized on fully confirming the required aggregate row plus the Bestsellers/Clearance deliverables. No 'New Collection'/'New Season' editorial-only page was found anywhere on the site (checked main nav, footer, and the New Arrivals page itself) - the only New-related page is this genuine product listing, so no Collection-page ambiguity applies here (the §3 'Collection' test is moot: there's no separately-named 'New Collection' page to disambiguate from, just this one confirmed real PLP). No site search needed since real nav directly surfaced the canonical page.
